_comment: Copy to ~/.claude/db-targets.json (local-only, never committed). devHosts: hosts any client may reach directly (hooks/lib/sql-target.js) - add the compose service names you use as -h. targets: <workspace root> -> <env> -> one non-dev database, read only through scripts/db-ro.ps1 (/db), longest root wins. engine: sqlserver (default) | postgres | redis. server: host,port (sqlserver) or host:port. Secrets: user + password, or auth (a connection-string fragment); any value may be a literal, env:NAME or envfile:<path>#KEY. databases: the allowed names (redis: indexes, default 0). Optional: encrypt, trustServerCertificate, applicationIntent (sqlserver); sslmode (postgres); tls (redis); clientImage (postgres, redis: the docker route's image); readOnlyAttested (redis only, used only when the server hides its ACL so the probe cannot prove read-only: who verified the access policy, and when). The probe refuses (exit 3) any credential with a write grant.
